name: Products Used by Agency
query: MATCH p = (a:FedRAMP_Agency)-[:FedRAMP_Contains*0..1]->(user:FedRAMP_Agency)-[:FedRAMP_Authorizes|FedRAMP_Reuses]->(prod:FedRAMP_Product) WHERE a.objectid = 'CHANGE' RETURN p
description: Show products an agency (or its sub-agencies) authorizes or reuses. Click the agency, copy its Object ID, replace CHANGE, then run.
